items.docs: The Cardholder Authentication API for 3DS authenticates the cardholder and leads to a challenge flow or a frictionless flow adhering to the Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) directive. For further details, refer to  [Server-to-Server Payments with 3D Secure](https://docs.verifone.com/online-payments/api-integration/server-to-server-payments-with-3d-secure-setup-guide/server-to-server-payments-with-3d-secure#step-11b__003a-__0028client__002dside__0029-pares__005fstatus-__003d-__201cc__201d-con
